text_blocks.snippet: Central Illinois residents face a surge in targeted scams, including AI-generated voice and impersonation schemes, fake text messages, and law enforcement/jury duty threats.
snippet_highlighted_words: AI-generated voice and impersonation schemes, fake text messages, and law enforcement/jury duty threats

text_blocks.snippet: Common Active Scams in Central Illinois

list.snippet: AI Voice & Imposter Calls: Scammers use AI tools to clone voices or pose as federal prosecutors, sheriff's deputies, or local financial institutions (such as CEFCU warns of imposter scams ), demanding immediate payment or sensitive data.
Jury Duty & Court Scams: Fraudsters call claiming you missed jury duty or have an active citation, pressuring you to visit or pay to avoid arrest.

Tollway & State Agency Texts: Fake text messages impersonate the Illinois Secretary of State or tollway authorities claiming missed tolls or license issues. Note: The Secretary of State only texts for scheduled DMV appointments and never about registration or enforcement.
Sextortion / Bitcoin Threats: Emails threatening to release explicit photos unless a Bitcoin payment is made, often including a street view of the victim's house pulled from public data.
Home Improvement / Driveway Paving: Transient paving crews returning to Central Illinois neighborhoods with fraudulent or shoddy contractor work.

text_blocks.snippet: How to Protect Yourself & Report Scams

list.snippet: Hang up and verify: Never trust caller ID or urgent threats. Call the agency or bank directly using a verified, independent phone number.
Do not click links: Avoid clicking links in unexpected text messages or emails regarding tolls, DMV statuses, or packages.
File a consumer complaint or track trends via the Federal Trade Commission Report Fraud Portal .

snippet_links.text: Federal Trade Commission Report Fraud Portal

list.snippet: Report cyber-related impersonation or spoofing to the FBI Tips Page .
Check or log local incidents through the Better Business Bureau Scam Tracker .

text_blocks.snippet: If you or someone you know was recently targeted, tell me how they were contacted (phone call, text, email, or in-person) so I can give you the exact steps to secure your accounts.
